entries.reason: The picture note screen preserves the same no-person words and closed clothing aspect for nonhuman things and creatures. Anatomy and part layout are available only in the versioned things picture vocabulary. The reader still refuses a picture containing a human person or readable writing; the word screen is an additional deterministic check, not a substitute for that refusal.
